shadcn/no-restyle.message: "{{className}}" is not allowed on <{{component}}>, which owns its {{category}}. An element may set layout, spacing, type, colour, shape and effects from the token map, without blend modes (Rule 8). Core is never edited or forked (Rules 1 and 7).
